subject: mathematics
concept: Communicating a mathematical model and its results clearly to a non-mathematical audience
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to Literacy's argument-writing skills — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student converts a technical model result into a simple chart or visual for a general audience
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short, jargon-free explanation of their model and its real-world conclusion

assessment.mastery_threshold: explanation is accurate and genuinely understandable without prior math background
misconception_flags: explanation relies on technical notation or jargon without translating it for a general audience

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
